remarks: Nestled on a rare acre-plus parcel in a prime sought-after location near the Westport border, this charming vintage Cape offers easy access to shops, restaurants, and the train station while providing an exceptional blend of privacy, beauty, and timeless character. A classic white picket fence welcomes you into a storybook setting filled with mature flowering trees, lush gardens, and a charming pastel entry door. Rich in historic charm yet thoughtfully updated for modern living, the home features hardwood floors throughout much of the main level and an effortless flow ideal for both entertaining and everyday living. At the heart of the home is a sun-drenched Great Room with a wood-burning fireplace and Jotul wood stove, creating a cozy retreat during the winter months. A geothermal HVAC system provides impressive energy efficiency and relief from rising oil costs. An inviting sunroom overlooking the expansive grounds offers the perfect place to work, read, or unwind. The designer Kitchen with counter seating opens seamlessly to the formal Dining Room and spacious deck for easy al fresco entertaining. The first floor also includes a spacious Bedroom and Full Bath, ideal for guests or one-level living. Upstairs are two generously sized Bedrooms and a beautifully renovated Full Bath with laundry. The lower level adds valuable living space with a finished playroom, abundant storage, and an attached one-car garage.
